name: EXM_SPEND_AUTH_DISTS
description: This table contains distribution information for a specific spend authorization expense line.

columns.name: SPEND_AUTH_DIST_ID
columns.description: Distribution identifier of spend authorization expense line.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SPEND_AUTHORIZATION_ID
columns.description: Spend authorization identifier, which includes spend authorization expense line corresponding to distribution.

columns.name: SPEND_AUTH_LINE_ID
columns.description: Spend authorization expense line identifier for distribution.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Accounting code combination for which authorization line is created.

columns.name: AUTHORIZED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount to be authorized to individual against authorization distribution.

columns.name: COST_CENTER
columns.description: Cost center for which authorization line is created.

columns.name: COMPANY
columns.description: Company for which authorization line is created.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: FUNDS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of funds returned by Oracle Budgetary Control API for  authorization request distribution. Possible values are from XCC_BC_FUNDS_STATUSES lookup. Example of values are IN_PROCESS, NOT_ATTEMPTED and RESERVED_PASSED.

columns.name: PJC_CONTEXT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Segment used to identify descriptive flexfield application context for project-related standardized cost collection.

columns.name: PJC_PROJECT_ID
columns.description: Project identifier used to build transaction descriptive flexfield for project-related transaction distributions.

columns.name: PJC_TASK_ID
columns.description: Task identifier used to build transaction descriptive flexfield for project-related transaction distributions.

columns.name: PJC_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Expenditure type used to build transaction descriptive flexfield for project-related transaction distributions.

columns.name: PJC_EXPENDITURE_ITEM_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a project-related expense is incurred.

columns.name: PJC_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Expenditure organization identifier used to build transaction descriptive flexfield for project-related transaction distributions.

columns.name: PJC_BILLABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a project-related item is available to be billed to customers.

columns.name: PJC_CAPITALIZABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a project-related item is eligible for capitalization.

columns.name: PJC_WORK_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Project-related classification identifier of work performed.

columns.name: PJC_CONTRACT_ID
columns.description: Contract identifier. This attribute is used when Oracle Contract Billing or Oracle Grants Accounting is installed.

columns.name: PJC_CONTRACT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Tracks contract line information. This attribute is used when Oracle Contract Billing or Oracle Grants Accounting is installed.

columns.name: PJC_FUNDING_ALLOCATION_ID
columns.description: Specifies name of the project funding override. This attribute is used when Oracle Contract Billing or Oracle Grants Accounting is installed
